changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "log".turanix_log ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, user_id UUID, msisdn TEXT, pinfl TEXT, status TEXT, error_message TEXT, request TEXT, response TEXT, request_time TIMESTAMP, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
